snippet.title: Quick Whiskers | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
#AfilGames #QuickWhiskers
✨Quick Whiskers Launch Traler!
🐾 Reflexes, precision and fast feline action!
Quick Whiskers is a pixel-art platformer where every move matters. Dash through 30 levels between the park and the city, collect the cans and reach the cozy bed at the end of each stage! 🐱
Available starting November 27 with 20% off on Xbox and Microsoft Store! 🎮

KEY FEATURES
🐾 Walk, jump, and dash precisely to navigate each stage
🐾 Springs and balloons launch your cat to higher areas
🐾 Spikes, saws, and unstable platforms test your reflexes

Grab Yours 👇👇👇
🎮 Xbox Series: https://x.gd/49ed4
🎮 Xbox One: https://x.gd/7ZQdJ
💻 Microsoft Store (Windows): https://x.gd/Tc5YIS
